NOTE:  PUBLIC PARTICIPATION INFORMATION
  Agenda reports and other disclosable public records relating to each Open Session agenda item are
  available on the City's web site under City Council Meeting agendas at www.RollingHillsEstates.gov and
  during regular business hours in the office of the City Clerk. Meetings are live broadcast on the City's web
  site and a recording is available for viewing after each meeting. Meetings are also broadcast on PVP -TV
  Channel 35 (Cox) and Channel 39 (Verizon).

  Public Comment is welcome on any item during City Council consideration of the item. An opportunity is
  also provided for the public to comment on non-agenda items concerning City matters. If you would like to
  address the City Council regarding an item on this agenda or make a general public comment, please
  complete a speaker sheet and give to the City Clerk.

  Members of the public may listen to the meeting live by calling: (1-669-444-9171) from any phone,
  Meeting ID: 859 2139 6406, Meeting Password: 956186. (Please note you will not have the ability to
  speak using the call-in option from a phone line.) Members of the public who wish to speak during this
  meeting may join the Zoom meeting by accessing the Zoom app from a computer (downloaded at
  Zoom.com) or tablet or phone (downloaded in the App Store), by entering the following credentials:
  Meeting ID: 859 2139 6406, Meeting Password: 956186.  Members of the public who join the Zoom
  meeting will not have video, and may request to speak using the following process: After joining the Zoom
  meeting, if you wish to speak, please select the "raise hand" option at the lower portion of your screen.
  The City Clerk will send you a chat message to identify which item on the agenda you would like to speak
  on and will unmute your mic at the appropriate time.

  Agenda reports and other disclosable public records relating to each Open Session agenda item are
  available on the City's website under Meeting Agendas, Minutes & Videos at www.rhe.city.

5.  CONSENT CALENDAR
  The following routine matters will be acted upon by one vote to approve with the majority consent of the
  City Council. There will be no separate discussion of these items unless good cause is shown by a member
  prior to the roll call vote. (Items removed for individual consideration will be voted on separately.)

  A.  READING OF ORDINANCES AND RESOLUTIONS
  Reading in full of all ordinances and resolutions presented for consideration to the
  City Council will be waived and all such ordinances and resolutions will be read by
  title only.
  B.  SCHEDULE OF INVESTMENTS REPORT OF SEPTEMBER 2024
  Recommendation: Receive and file.
  Attachments: Staff Report

  C.  REVENUE AND EXPENDITURE REPORT OF SEPTEMBER 2024
  Recommendation: Receive and file.

  110124 through 110324; in the amount of $396,711.92; for a grand total amount of
  $2,120,231.07 with proper audit.
  Attachments: Demands & Warrants

  E.  EQUESTRIAN COMMITTEE MINUTES OF SEPTEMBER 23, 2024

  K.  NOTICE OF COMPLETION - PVDN ROAD REPAIR PROJECT-EAST OF
  ROLLING HILLS ROAD - MENDOZA ENGINEERING COMPANY, INC.
  Recommendation: That the City Council: 1) Accept the PVDN Road Repair Project

  with the Los Angeles County Recorder’s Office, and 3) If no claims are filed within
  35 days after recordation, direct staff to release the 5% construction retention
  payment to Mendoza Engineering Company, Inc. in the amount of $3,091.33.
  Attachments: Staff Report

7.  PUBLIC HEARINGS

  A.  PLANNING APPLICATION NO. 230516
  CONSIDERATION OF A PRECISE PLAN OF DESIGN, A COMMERCIAL
  DISTRICT MIXED-USE DEVELOPMENT PERMIT, A DEVELOPMENT
  AGREEMENT, AND AN ADDENDUM TO THE GENERAL PLAN FINAL
  PROGRAM ENVIRONMENTAL IMPACT REPORT FOR THE 2040
  GENERAL PLAN (SCH NO. 2021050450) FOR A 90-UNIT APARTMENT
  PROJECT ON A 2-ACRE SITE
  APPLICANT: RYAN ASH ON BEHALF OF VESTAR
  LOCATION: 27525 NORRIS CENTER DRIVE (APN 7589-005-020)
  Memorandum from Whitney Berry, Senior Planner
  Recommendation: That the City Council: 1) Open the Public Hearing; 2) Take public
  testimony; 3) Discuss the issues; 4) Close the Public Hearing; 5) Adopt Resolution
  No. 2588, approving a Commercial District Mixed-Use Development Permit
  (MUD-230517) and a Precise Plan of Design (PPD-240299), and adopting the
  Addendum to the 2040 General Plan Environmental Impact Report (SCH No.
  2021050450); and 6) Re-open the Public Hearing 7) Introduce for first reading,
  Ordinance No. 750; 8) Continue the Public Hearing for a second reading and
  adoption of Ordinance No. 750, to the City Council meeting of December 10, 2024.
  Attachments: Staff Report

  B.  COST RECOVERY POLICY/ANNUAL UPDATE MECHANISM FOR THE
  USER FEE UPDATE - COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT AND PUBLIC
  WORKS DEPARTMENTS
  Memorandum from Jeannie Naughton, Community Development Director
  Recommendation: That the City Council: 1) Open the Public Hearing; 2) Take public
  testimony; 3) Discuss the issues related to the user fee schedules for the Community
  Development and Public Works Departments and the User Fee Cost Recovery Level
  Policy; 4) Close the Public Hearing; 5) Adopt Resolution No. 2589, to amend the
  Comprehensive Schedule of Municipal Fees and Charges for the Fiscal Year
  2024-25; and 6) Adopt Resolution No. 2590, adopting a User Fee Cost Recovery
  Level Policy for all City departments.
  Attachments: Staff Report + Resolution Nos. 2589 & 2590

  C.  RESOLUTION NO. 2591 AMENDING PERSONNEL RULES

  Memorandum from Alexa Davis, Assistant City Manager
  Recommendation: That the City Council 1) open the Public Hearing and take any
  public testimony; 2) close the Public Hearing; and 3) review and adopt Resolution
  No. 2591 amending the City’s Personnel Rules.
  Attachments: Staff Report + Resolution No. 2591

8.  NEW BUSINESS

  A.  ADOPTION OF FY 2024-25 PUBLICLY AVAILABLE PAY SCHEDULE

  Memorandum from Alexa Davis, Assistant City Manager
  Recommendation: That the City Council approve a Publicly Available Pay Schedule
  for the 2024-25 fiscal year in accordance with California Public Employees'
  Retirement System (CalPERS) regulations.
  Attachments: Staff Report

  B.  FOUNDERS PARK PROJECT: REQUEST TO APPROVE AN AMENDMENT
  TO PUBLIC WORKS CONTRACT WITH KORMEX CONSTRUCTION INC.
  TO COMPLETE THE PROJECT
  LOCATION: 2483 PALOS VERDES DRIVE NORTH
  Memorandum from David Wahba, Director of Public Works
  Recommendation: That the City Council approve a First Amendment to the Public
  Works Contract with Kormex Construction in the amount of $59,000, to complete
  the Founders Park Project, in form satisfactory to the City Attorney.
  Attachments: Staff Report

11.  CITY COUNCIL / REGIONAL COMMITTEE REPORTS
